custody_model: Subscribed assets were transferred from the user's Spot Wallet to a centrally administered Earn account
yield_source: Interest generated through BitMart Savings arrangements, with the user agreement permitting BitMart Group Entities to use subscribed assets for operating purposes including loans to clients or affiliates
risk_notes: Flexible and fixed products had different redemption constraints. Users faced platform, counterparty, deployment, liquidity, term, maturity, withdrawal, compliance-review, and wind-down risk; advertised APY and redemption descriptions did not guarantee profit or eliminate loss.

custody_model: Assets moved from Spot Wallet to Earn Wallet and were administered by BitMart for on-chain staking or other supported earning activities
yield_source: On-chain staking rewards, interest compensation, project incentives, marketing programs, or other product-specific earning activities
risk_notes: Product pages combined PoS and non-PoS earning sources. Users faced lock-up, protocol, counterparty, platform, reward variability, redemption, and wind-down risks, and fixed products could restrict early redemption.

custody_model: Collateral was frozen and controlled within BitMart accounts under centrally administered loan and liquidation terms
yield_source: Borrower interest and, where enabled at loan initiation, Flexible Savings yield on pledged collateral
risk_notes: Borrowers faced collateral valuation, liquidation, interest-rate, repayment, suspension, release, compliance, and wind-down risks. Optional Savings yield on collateral did not remove the underlying loan or platform risks.

custody_model: Users retained stated ownership while authorizing Kriptomat to place supported assets into protocol staking through an Earn sub-account and partner or protocol infrastructure
yield_source: Dynamic Proof-of-Stake protocol rewards, less product fees or commissions reflected in displayed net reward estimates
risk_notes: Rewards were variable and protocol-dependent. Deposits and withdrawals could be delayed by protocol-specific periods, services could be suspended for legal or policy reasons, and partner, protocol, network, cybersecurity, fee, custody-interface, and wind-down risks remained.
